title: Equation of State
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly state Van der Waal's equation of state for a real gas.

title: Physical Interpretation
description: Important Criteria: The student should provide a clear physical interpretation of the constants a and b in the context of real gases.

title: Critical Constants
description: Essential Criteria: The student must express the constants a and b in terms of the critical data.

title: Correct Derivations
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly derive the relationships involving the critical point conditions.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common sign mistakes in the derivation of the equation.
